activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, washing face and brushing teeth
Making and eating a quick breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and toasting bread
Changing into work clothes, checking phone messages and packing work bag
Commuting to the hospital for the morning shift
Working as a health care professional: patient check-ups, charting and coordinating with the care team
Taking a lunch break and eating a packed meal
Continuing clinical duties: patient care, medication rounds and record keeping
Cooking dinner and eating it while listening to music
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV after the shift
Taking a warm shower and washing up
Winding down on the computer, reviewing the next day's schedule under the desk lamp
